**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/02/12 (Sun) 21:20
- [FACT] The user provided a list of immigration classifications and requirements.
- [FACT] The user mentioned the E-2 CNMI investor classification, which is for aliens seeking to enter or remain in the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands (CNMI).
- [FACT] The E-2 CNMI investor classification is specifically limited to an alien investor who has previously been granted a qualifying long-term investor status under the laws of the CNMI.
- [FACT] The E-2 CNMI investor classification allows an eligible alien to be lawfully present in the CNMI to maintain the investment during the transition period from CNMI to Federal immigration law.
- [FACT] The E-2 CNMI investor classification expires on December 31, 2029.
- [FACT] A petition for the initial issuance of an E-2 CNMI investor classification must be filed within 2 years of January 18, 2011.
- [FACT] Petitions for the initial issuance of the E-2 CNMI filed after January 18, 2013 will be rejected.
- [FACT] Requests for extension of the E-2 CNMI investor classification may be granted in increments of not more than 2 years until December 31, 2029.
- [FACT] Applications for the dependents of E-2 CNMI investors must be filed on Form I-539, Application to Extend/Change Nonimmigrant Status.
- [FACT] The user provided details about the H-1B classification for aliens coming to the United States temporarily to perform services in a specialty occupation.
- [FACT] A specialty occupation requires a bachelor’s or higher degree in a specific specialty or its equivalent.
- [FACT] The petition for H-1B must be filed by a U.S. employer or a U.S. agent.
- [FACT] The petition must include evidence of a labor condition application (LCA) certified by the U.S. Department of Labor.
- [FACT] The petition must show that the proposed employment qualifies as a specialty occupation.
- [FACT] The petition must include evidence that the beneficiary has the required degree or equivalent experience.
- [FACT] The petition must include a copy of any required license or permission to practice the occupation in the state of intended employment.
- [FACT] The petition must include a copy of any written contract between the petitioner and the beneficiary or a summary of the terms of the oral agreement.
- [FACT] If filing an H-1B cap petition, a valid Beneficiary Confirmation Number must be provided.
- [FACT] The user mentioned that the H-1B classification is also for aliens coming to perform services of an exceptional nature relating to a cooperative research and development project administered by the U.S. Department of Defense (DOD).
